a: `nativeSvgKind('texture')` reports a native SVG form, so a texture fill exports as a bare dangling `url(#id)` with no fallback
A white seed color written as `#fff`, `white` or `rgb(255,255,255)` seeds an invisible white-to-white gradient
A lazily loaded kind that fails `registerPaintKind`'s validation is dropped silently and never retried
`withPaintKind` skips a registered override of a built-in gradient kind
A gradient's `colorOf` reads `stops[0]` by array position, not by lowest offset
b: A lazily loaded kind that fails `registerPaintKind`'s stopsOf/fromStops check never registers and logs nothing
`getPaintKind` reads its own registry but decides whether to load from the renderer's, so the two can disagree and the editor half never loads
A gradient seeded from white written as anything other than `#ffffff…` ramps white to white
`meshGradientKind`'s doc names a module `./registerMesh` that does not exist
